provenance.paper_title: M2A: Multimodal Memory Agent with Dual-Layer Hybrid Memory for Long-Term Personalized Interactions

representation_paths.memory_component: immutable raw conversation and image log

evidence.paraphrase: The append-only RawMessageStore preserves complete multimodal messages in chronological order and remains addressable through evidence identifiers.
Semantic entries combine high-level descriptions, image captions, associated images, and pointers to supporting raw-message ranges; dense, sparse, and visual rankings are fused.

MemoryManager analyzes prior entries and executes create, delete, or modify operations after ChatAgent requests an update. For M2A, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of immutable raw conversation and image log.

evidence.section: Full paper: M2A: Multimodal Memory Agent for Personalized Interactions
evidence.paraphrase: MemoryManager compares a new interaction with related memories and removes or replaces outdated and conflicting semantic entries. For M2A, this specifically supports LLM-based resolution of conflicting records of immutable raw conversation and image log.

derived.hybrid_relation: Editable semantic observations and their image fields remain linked by evidence_ids to immutable raw messages.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (immutable raw conversation and image log) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, LLM-based resolution of conflicting records; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
